prompt.description: Text description of the image, or of the edit when images are given, up to 32,000 characters. Refer to reference images by their order, e.g. "image 1".

images.description: Reference images for image editing and multi-reference generation, 1 to 16: https URLs or data:image/<format>;base64 URIs (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC or HEIF; 128 to 8192 px per side; long side at most 4x the short side). When set, the request is an image edit.

n.description: Number of images to generate, 1 to 10

size.description: Exact output size as WIDTHxHEIGHT, e.g. 2720x1536: area 655,360 to 20,000,000 pixels, aspect ratio between 1:3 and 3:1. Cannot be combined with aspect_ratio or area.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio when size is not set: auto (default, chosen from the prompt) or X:Y with X and Y from 1 to 300, between 1:3 and 3:1, e.g. 16:9 or 21:9

area.description: Output area level when size is not set, targeting 1024x1024, 2048x2048 or 4096x4096 pixels at the chosen aspect ratio. Defaults to 4K.

disable_prompt_enhanced.description: Text-to-image only: use the prompt as written instead of the enhanced prompt. Requires size or an X:Y aspect_ratio.

output_format.description: Output image format. Defaults to jpeg.

output_compression.description: JPEG or WEBP quality, 0 to 100 (default 95); ignored for png
